purpose: Save one administration setting by key.

fields.name: key
fields.values: a setting key, as GET /access/config lists

notes: Saves one setting. key is '<section>.<item>' (only access, customization and branding sections), value its value; the server saves it with no client (the default client). GET /access/config?key=<section>.<item>&client=<id> reads one setting as {<item>: value} (both parameters required: 'Invalid or missing JSON Key/value.' otherwise). Tested by saving branding.titleColor with its current value.

purpose: Turn DNs of any entity type into display names, with each one's entity type.
List a group's members.
answer: {recipients:[{name, dn, isGroupAssignment, targetSetList:[{name, dn, allUsers, includeManager, readOnly}]}], arraySize, nextIndex, …}
notes: Works once a group has members: like /groups/members, but each member also lists the teams that reach them (targetSetList): the real team they are in (named by its generated cn, not its display name) plus the three virtual administrator teams (Role Admin Team, Resource Admin Team, Provision Request Defination Admin Team, with DNs such as Role_Admin_Virtual_Team_Dn). size=1 paged; sortOrder=desc reversed the order. A DN that is not a group answers 489 'Invalid Group Detected'. Errors seen on the lab: right after a group was created, or a group that does not exist → 489 'Invalid Group Detected: [<DN>].'.

purpose: The landing page's categories and items (the tiles), with or without their images.
notes: Item ids and categories are per installation (the landing page's configuration).

purpose: Images for a given set of landing-page items.
notes: Read-only despite POST: returns the images of the given items.

purpose: Save the landing page's items.
notes: Updates existing items by itemId (id = the item's external id, both required). Send the items flattened from the GET. Item names are stored once per item and locale and shared by PUT …/ulp/items and PUT …/ulp/landingItems/v2: on the lab the two reads showed different names for two items (the client view 'Search User', the admin list 'Search'), and saving either list back unchanged overwrote the other's name. Only one of the two can be put back; the client view was restored.

purpose: For the workflow engine: the best locale for each user.
notes: Only for calls made by the workflow engine (the server checks a workflow-request flag on the session); a person's token gets 489 'Unauthorized user'.

fields.values: process (PRD) id; required when includeDelegations is true

notes: Workflow engine only: a person's token gets 489 'Unauthorized user'.

notes: An empty body answers arraySize 0.

purpose: Users a team manager may act for (the team's recipients).

params.name: proxyUser
params.values: DN to act as a proxy for

notes: Lists the people the caller may act for as a team manager (for a domain administrator: everyone in the user root), each with the teams that reach them. q matches the name.

purpose: Search teams.
answer: {teams:[{name, dn, description, recipients:[{name, dn, type, isGroupAssignment}], requestors:[…], allUsers, includeManager, localizedNames, localizedDescriptions, readOnly, domainTypes}], …}
notes: Shows the team at once (no forceRefresh needed); q matched the team name; sortBy=name with sortOrder=desc and forceRefresh=true also worked. Each team comes with its full recipients and requestors (team managers).

purpose: The signed-in person's tasks, simple form.
notes: still {total:0} for the administrator while a role approval task addressed to another user was open (GET …/tasks/list listed that task).

purpose: The signed-in person's DN and full name.
Full names for a list of user DNs.
Photos for a list of users.
answer: 204 when none of them has a photo
notes: The lab's administrator has no photo, so it answered 204.

purpose: Quick information on one user: their attributes with labels and data types.
notes: The attributes shown are per installation (the quick-info configuration).

purpose: Quick information on several users.
Search users (older form of /users/list).

params.name: sortOrder
params.values: asc or desc (checked) but did not change the order on the lab

answer: {members:[{dn, firstName, lastName}], nextIndex (0 = no more, else the next start), arraySize, token}
notes: q matches first and last name (contains), not cn or title: a first name and a last name found people, a cn prefix and a title found nothing; an empty q lists everyone in the user search root. sortBy accepts only FirstName (anything else: 489 'Invalid sort-by column: LastName'); sortOrder asc/desc is checked, but the order did not follow it: three users came back in the same order for both asc and desc. Paging: size=2 gave nextIndex 3, the next page nextIndex 0. limit=2 did not cut the list of 3. The token names a server-side cache of the result; forceRefresh=true with the token drops it.

purpose: The administrator roles (security domains) a user holds, by name.
notes: With a role assigned: the role's display name (names only, no DNs). Correction: the earlier write-up said these were only the applications' administrator assignments; with data, an ordinary IDM role assigned to the user is listed too.

purpose: List the subcontainers of a container, of a role level's container, or of the resource container.

fields.name: level
fields.values: a role level; lists that level's container

notes: With none of the fields it lists the entity's search root. A field named dn is ignored. The server reads containers with a system context, not the caller's rights.

purpose: Search groups.
answer: {groups:[{id, name, description}], arraySize, nextIndex (0 = no more), token}
notes: q matches the description (contains); the group's cn found nothing. sortBy=Description with desc reversed the order. Paging: size=1 gave nextIndex 2, then 0. The id field is the DN (here it is called id, in /access/groups dn).

purpose: Create a role category.
notes: 489 'Unable to find abstract layer object definition for the specified definition key.': like POST …/resources/category, the server looks up a directory abstraction layer entity this installation does not define. Nothing was created.

purpose: A role's assignments, with paging, sorting and a filter by source.

params.name: sourceTypes
params.values: repeatable; the assignment sources to include

answer: {assignmentStatusList:[{dn, recipientType:'USER', recipientTypeSubContainer, recipientDn, recipientFullName, statusCode:'50', statusDisplay:'Completed', effectiveDate (epoch ms as string), expiryDate, description, grant}], nextIndex, arraySize, total, hasmore}
notes: The body field is dn here, not id as in v1: {id: …} gives 489 'Invalid input DN: '. statusCode 50 = Completed; description is the assign-time reason; grant true for an assignment. Limited to the user search root, like v1.

purpose: Search separation-of-duties constraints.

fields.name: roles
fields.values: [{id: role DN}]: the SoDs any of these roles is part of

notes: Finds the SoDs that involve the given roles (one role gave both of its SoDs). {} or a body without roles answers {arraySize:0}, and q alone finds nothing: it is not a search of all SoDs (use GET …/catalog/sods for that).
